title.label: BIG FAN but could you please add this back?

content.label:
So I know it’s probably won’t see this, BUT IF YOU DO, I am one of your biggest fans and I have played this game since 2019, (My dad has played since 2011) and there used to be a world type called “Old”. There three world types: “Flat”, “Infinite”, and “Old”. Old was actually my favorite world type, I don’t know why, I just liked to build in a limited amount of space. But then one day you removed it. I had several worlds that were old, I have NO IDEA what happened to those :(. Luckily it didn’t delete my favorite one though. Actually I didn’t know I still had that world until about two months ago, I wanted to see if I had any “Old” worlds still which I didn’t think I did, but I looked anyway, and I found that one! But any way, I found the world, and I WAS SHOCKED, the world seemed to have gotten cut off or smaller, because I swear I have a very vivid memory of a hillside with a village on it, that was gone (maybe it was a different world?). What WAS still there was a abandoned village I had built some stuff on and “Repaired” the not really “abandoned” village anymore XD, I didn’t really fix it much though. And also that hill wasn’t there, I do remember the abandoned village being separate from the not abandoned one on the hill. Everything else seemed fine though. Mostly everything… BECAUSE for some reason (and I don’t really care about this too much) the up to 2 chunks sometimes 1 by the wall (Made of invisible bedrock) are corrupted. There not different chunks, they are literally just chunks that don’t really load. But even if you can’t fix my world, I would still highly appreciate if you could add the “Old” world type back, Thank you. [Edit] I just went in the settings/options for the “Old” world and I just realized that there is a update to infinite button. so I duplicated the world and it does in-fact change the world to infinite. So I don’t know if you just don’t want to add it back. But still I would love if you could add the “Old” world type back. I make mods by the way and not super complicated mods, well, sometimes. And I sometimes do file exploring too, not often but sometimes. And I don’t know if the code for the “Old” world type is just laying around in there or what but yeah, I could actually try and look into that if you want me to, I honestly do that kind of thing for fun. But yeah, again, I would highly appreciate it if you could bring the “Old” world type back, it means a lot to me. Thank You.
